title: 第十七章 破案关键疑犯越狱第十八章 碧髓玉化背后有人
content_zh:
“哈哈~”
“怎么？总捕头想亲自对我动手么？”
嘣！
庆丰踏前一步，脚下铁索应声而断，灼热的阳刚血气直逼铁棠而去。
世间传闻肉身强横者，能靠自身血气逼退魑魅魍魉，使寻常阴物不敢近其周身。
铁棠估摸着.....这条传闻大抵是真的。
如今他离庆丰不过三尺之距，已经能够感受到对方雄浑的血气，如同燃烧着熊熊烈焰，热浪逼人。
不过！
他如今亦是易筋大成的修为，何惧之有？
“庆捕头，你误会了！”
铁棠伸出右臂，握手如爪，犹如蜻蜓点水般，朝着庆丰手腕轻轻一点。
嘭！
这一下如同小鸡啄米，又快又急。
庆丰根本来不及反应，已然中招，整个手掌像是腕关节被人折断一般，无力地垂了下来。
“大力鹰爪功，点穴分筋？”庆丰满脸惊疑，不敢置信。
铁棠重新负手，笑道：“铁某不是来杀你的，若真要杀你，何须自己出手？”
“你的修为实力怎么进步如此之快？”庆丰根本不敢相信，明明清晨见到的铁棠还是锻骨境修为。
可刚刚那一下.......绝对有易筋境的实力。
“你关注的重点似乎错了，你要死了，庆县捕。”
庆丰警戒地退后三步，不屑道：“除非你现在出手杀我，否则我怎么会死？”

“我自不会杀你，不过有人要借朝廷之手杀你，有人要借律法之刀斩你。
大势所趋，又岂是铁某能够阻拦？”
“堂堂铁神捕，莫非查了一天.....还看不出庆某不是真凶？”庆丰即便不喜铁棠，也认为他绝对是破案的高手，潜意识还是相信他的。
自己是不是凶手不重要，只要铁棠相信不是，那就不是。
反之——亦然！
牢房内本是阴暗、潮湿，但两位易筋大成刚刚爆发血气，很是驱散了一阵阴霾。
皎洁月光从小窗栏杆缝隙挤了进来，洒在二人身上，如同批了一层银纱。
铁棠微微一笑，目光注视庆丰：“庆县捕，你可能没有搞清现在的情况，让我给你捋捋。
案发时，伱不在家中，对吧？
你的刀，是不见了吗？
翠红，还记得么？
她死了！
你现在是黄泥巴抹裤裆——不是屎也是屎！”
铁棠的声音越来越大，庆丰的脸色却是越来越白。
每一句话都如重锤敲打在他心头，让他不自觉倒退，到了最后，更是一屁股坐在干草堆上，呆滞不语。
良久，庆丰回过神来。
“你....都知道了？”
铁棠摇了摇头：“铁某所知不过表象，还需庆县捕老实交代，若是庆县捕不愿......铁某马上离开。”
庆丰沉默，久久未语，他还搞不清铁棠的真正意图，一时半会不敢相信。
眼见如此，铁棠转身就走。

对方死不死他是真不关心，左右也是个碍眼的，拿去结案也算美事。
何况庆丰的确没有洗掉嫌疑，依旧是疑犯之一。
“等等，你先回答我一个问题。”庆丰有些急了。
“你说，我不一定回答。”铁棠背对着庆丰，月色照不到这个角落，只能看到一个黑影。
content_en:
"Haha~"
"What? Does the chief catcher want to do something to me personally?"
Boom!
Qingfeng took a step forward, and the iron rope under his feet broke with a sound, and the hot masculine blood rushed towards Tie Tang.
It is said in the world that a physically powerful person can use his own blood to drive away demons and demons, so that ordinary evil objects dare not come near him.
Tie Tang guessed...this rumor was probably true.
Now that he was only three feet away from Qingfeng, he could already feel the opponent's vigorous blood, like burning flames and a heat wave.
but!
He is now a master of Yi Jin, so why should he be afraid?
"Qing Baotou, you misunderstood!"
Tie Tang stretched out his right arm, shook hands like a claw, and tapped Qing Feng's wrist like a dragonfly touching water.
Bang!
This time it was like a chicken pecking at rice, fast and urgent.
Qingfeng didn't have time to react, he was already hit, and his entire palm hung down feebly as if his wrist joint had been broken.
"Strengthening the Eagle Claw Technique, tapping acupuncture points to separate tendons?" Qing Fengfeng's face was filled with surprise and disbelief.
Tie Tang put his hands behind his hands again and said with a smile: "Tie is not here to kill you. If he really wants to kill you, why would he take action himself?"
"How come your cultivation strength has improved so fast?" Qingfeng simply couldn't believe that the Tie Tang he saw early in the morning was still at the Bone Forging Realm.
But that moment just now... was definitely capable of the Yijin realm.
"Your focus seems to be wrong. You are going to die. Qing County arrests you."
Qingfeng took three steps back warily and said disdainfully: "Unless you kill me now, how can I die?"
"I will not kill you, but some people want to kill you with the help of the court, and some people want to kill you with the sword of the law.
The general trend is inevitable, how can Tie be able to stop it? "
"Tie Shen arrested, could it be that after a whole day of investigation... you still can't figure out that Qing is not the real culprit?" Even if Qingfeng doesn't like Tie Tang, he still thinks that he is definitely a master in solving crimes, and subconsciously still believes in him.
It doesn't matter whether he is the murderer or not, as long as Tie Tang believes he is not, then he is not.
vice versa!
The cell was originally dark and damp, but the two Yi Jin Dacheng's burst of blood energy dispelled the gloom for a while.
The bright moonlight squeezed in through the gap in the railing of the small window and sprinkled on the two of them, like a layer of silver gauze.
Tie Tang smiled slightly and looked at Qingfeng: "Captain Qingxian, you may not understand the current situation, let me explain it to you.
You were not at home when the incident occurred, right?
Is your knife missing?
Cuihong, do you remember?
She is dead!
You are now covered in yellow mud smearing your crotch - it is either shit or shit! "
Tie Tang's voice became louder and louder, while Qing Feng's face became paler.
Every word hit his heart like a heavy hammer, making him retreat unconsciously. In the end, he sat down on the haystack, speechless.
After a long time, Qingfeng came back to his senses.
"You...know everything?"
Tie Tang shook his head: "Tie's knowledge is only superficial. We still need the Qingxian arrester to explain honestly. If the Qingxian arrester is unwilling... Tie will leave immediately."
Qingfeng was silent for a long time. He still couldn't figure out Tie Tang's true intention and couldn't believe it for a while.
Seeing this, Tie Tang turned around and left.
He really doesn't care whether the other party dies or not. He is also an eyesore on the left and right, so it would be a good thing to use it to close the case.
What's more, Qingfeng has indeed not been cleared of suspicion and is still one of the suspects.
"Wait a minute, answer me a question first." Qingfeng was a little anxious.
"You say, I may not answer." Tie Tang's back was to Qingfeng. The moonlight could not illuminate this corner, and he could only see a dark shadow.
